answer: Onyx birth: a fresh agent identity must first post collateral into a time-locked commitment. Trust then ripples outward to its referrals in capped waves, like a tide whose each later crest pays less and decays. A sybil flooder must front real, locked capital for every wave, and once decay sets in the economics turn negative, so cheap fake ids cost more than they can extract. Verification stays free; deception gets priced.
